nodes.label: BUGS_AUDIT.md
ConjuntOS — Verified Bug Audit (multi-agent, adversarially verified)
CRITICAL
✅ [security] Plaintext password stored for invited users
✅ [data-integrity] Anular multa does not void the linked pago — orphaned payable debt persists
[authz] IDOR on ad_spaces GET and PUT — no conjunto_id scope
HIGH
[authz] JWT `aud` claim disabled globally — WS tickets accepted as session tokens on REST endpoints
[security] No rate limiting on /auth/login — brute-force and credential-stuffing unrestricted
[security] Invited user password plaintext also returned to caller — password in API response
✅ [data-integrity] Payment re-submission on already-paid pago: TOCTOU race allows double-charging
[data-integrity] No positive-amount validation for gasto creation and editing (negative expenses inflate balance)
[tenancy] caso_id in emitir multa is not validated to belong to the same conjunto
[authz] Unauthenticated temporary-pass validation endpoint leaks cross-tenant guest data
[race-condition] Visitor parking reservation: TOCTOU race allows overbooking
[authz] ad_spaces impression and click tracking unauthenticated — cross-tenant counter manipulation
[perf] N+1 queries in comite_convivencia list handlers
[authz] firmar_acta has no tenant or caso scope — any user can sign any act
[tenancy] desactivar_miembro has no tenant scope — cross-conjunto committee member deactivation
[tenancy] Global (process-wide) admin status store — cross-tenant status bleed
[authz] switch_role allows tester accounts to escalate to SuperAdmin
[correctness] WebSocket onerror swallows the error without scheduling reconnect
[correctness] Quick-action buttons in admin-pqrs set state then immediately call handleCambiarEstado, which reads the stale closure value of nuevoEstado
[correctness] Optimistic message in sendMessage is never rolled back on network failure
[correctness] admin-mensajes: message list rendered with array index as key
[data-integrity] superadmin: logo upload stores raw base64 data URL in formData.logoUrl and sends it in the API payload
[data-integrity] Cartelera: Failed chat messages permanently stuck in UI with no error state
[correctness] Clasificados: null WhatsApp number produces 'wa.me/57null' broken URL
[correctness] Reservas: Day label in time-slot buttons always shows 'MIE' regardless of selected day
[data-integrity] Inmobiliaria: File index mismatch in edit mode causes wrong file removed on deletion
[correctness] Parqueadero: Historial de Accesos modal shows hardcoded fake data
[correctness] BottomNav: ARRENDATARIO role falls through to the wrong default tab set
[authz] BottomSheet: no focus trap — keyboard users can Tab behind the modal
[correctness] ChatSection: fetchMessages missing huespedId dependency causes wrong message filtering after prop change
[crash] AreaAdminDashboard: camera stream not stopped if component unmounts during scanning
[authz] ProfileHeader: notification panel is a non-semantic div with onClick — not keyboard accessible
MEDIUM
[security] WebSocket JWT ticket transmitted in URL query string — logged by proxies and servers
[perf] listar_gastos has no pagination limit — unbounded query over expense table
[security] Temporary-pass code is 32-character alphabet, 8 characters — weak against targeted brute-force
[security] Guest account password is set to the plain access code — credential reuse and predictability
[correctness] SOS state machine unit test has a contradictory assertion — coverage gap on Atendida→Atender invalid transition
[correctness] Silenced error result from registrar_transicion in servicios.rs
[perf] N+1 queries in encuestas listar — one tally query per survey
[security] No rate limiting on POST /admin/usuarios/invitar — invite spam and user enumeration
[correctness] Stale closure: login redirect reads `user` before Zustand commit
[correctness] Zustand `handlers` Map is mutated directly inside store state
[crash] `response.json()` called without try/catch — throws on malformed API responses
[correctness] ThemeProvider reads `localStorage` synchronously during SSR hydration — flash of wrong theme
[correctness] handleUploadAndSend sets sending=true a second time when it may already be set by the caller stopRecording path, and the optimistic audio message is also never rolled back on failure
[correctness] admin-analytics: fetch errors silently swallowed — page shows empty state with no user feedback
[crash] admin-banners: fetch errors silently swallowed, loading never reset on error, spinner stays forever
[data-integrity] admin-banners: form datetime-local input uses local timezone but converts to UTC ISO string, silently shifting dates
[correctness] admin-parqueadero: 'time ago' calculation in render produces -N min for future timestamps
[correctness] admin-residentes: currency display uses $Number().toLocaleString() which loses COP symbol and may display decimals
[authz] admin-mensajes: toggle buttons for availability lack visible ARIA labels — keyboard/screen reader users cannot identify them
[correctness] admin-mensajes: resident info tel link renders even when telefono is null, producing an empty tel: href
[correctness] Pases Temporales: vehiculos array mutation in onChange handlers mutates state directly
[correctness] Pagos: nequiPhone state not cleared after successful payment
[correctness] Visitantes: QR modal opened for past visits shows null qrData — no QR image visible
[correctness] Perfil: 'Otro Trámite' quick action button opens the VEHICULO registration modal
[correctness] CelebrationModal: global CSS class selectors inside GSAP context risk cross-instance collisions
[correctness] ProfileHeader: markAsRead reads stale notifications state to recompute unread count
[correctness] ProfileHeader: useEffect missing user/authLoading dependencies — data never refreshes on auth change
[perf] AreaAdminDashboard: scanFrame creates a new BarcodeDetector on every 500ms interval tick
[correctness] CallContext: isCitofoniaPage computed from window.location at render time, always false on server / stale after navigation
[correctness] CallContext: playRingtone and playBeep are called from WS handler and service worker message handler that bypass React's event system — AudioContext may stay in suspended state
[correctness] DocsVacunas: vaccine data fetched inside a forEach inside an effect — no cleanup, race on unmount
LOW
[security] Argon2id memory parameter is below OWASP 2023 minimum recommendation
[perf] morosidad endpoint exposes all delinquent units with no pagination
[security] citofonia/call accepts caller_name from request body without any length or content validation
[authz] SOS cancelar handler does not verify the alert belongs to the caller's conjunto before ownership check
[correctness] unwrap() on hard-coded time value in hot reservation path
[correctness] `CallProvider` profile fetch error logged with `console.error` — no user feedback
[correctness] admin-parqueadero: list rendered with array index as key — registros reorder will corrupt per-row state
[correctness] Novedades: loadNovedades called without cleanup — racing on rapid re-renders
[correctness] SearchModal: TypingText uses array index as key for parts split by regex
